basics.name: Sahil Kumar
basics.label: AI/ML Engineer
basics.description: Sahil Kumar, AI/ML engineer in India. Speech pipelines, retrieval systems, TinyML firmware and robots, built end to end and measured honestly.
basics.summary: Final-year ECE undergrad building ML systems end to end, from model to API to firmware: a speech pipeline that fits Whisper large-v3 and diarization on a 4 GB laptop GPU, a TinyML watchdog in pure C, a robot running vision, voice and motor control as concurrent loops. I publish the eval numbers, misses included.
basics.now: Writing an LLM serving engine from scratch: paged KV cache, continuous batching, Triton kernels.
